'''Cancelled Virtual Sets''' are [[Players Committee]] Virtual products that were planned or listed but '''not''' released in the form described &mdash; as opposed to [[Cancelled Expansions]], which covers '''Decipher''' expansions announced after [[Death Star II]] and never published.

This hub keeps virtual cancellations out of [[:Category:Cancelled sets]] (Decipher-only on this wiki). For Decipher cancelled product, see [[Cancelled Expansions]].

This is a '''fan encyclopedia''' page. It cites archived Players Committee posts and a Polish fan list; it does '''not''' invent set names, release dates, or second cancelled Virtual Sets without a source.

== Virtual Set 19: Galaxy at War (unreleased) ==

A Polish fan overview of Star Wars CCG Virtual Sets lists, under previous virtual expansions:

* '''Virtual Set 19: Galaxy at War (niewydany)''' &mdash; Polish ''niewydany'' = '''unreleased'''.<ref name="pl-vs">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG &mdash; Virtual Sets], Bastion Polskich Fan&oacute;w Star Wars (star-wars.pl)</ref>

On that page, '''only one''' entry is marked ''(niewydany)''. This research pass found '''no second''' cancelled Virtual Set labeled on that Polish list. A hunt for another cancelled VS number continues; do not treat silence as a second title.

No primary starwarsccg.org &ldquo;Galaxy at War cancelled&rdquo; announce was found in the same research pass beyond that Polish marking. Status on this wiki: '''planned Original-era Virtual Set 19, unreleased''' per the Polish list.

=== Naming collision: modern Virtual Set 19 ===

The modern set titled [[Virtual Set 19]] (Players Committee Current Virtual / Rebels-themed product, announced August 2022)<ref name="vs19-modern">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived/ The Beautiful and Thematic Virtual Set 19 Has Arrived], starwarsccg.org</ref> is a '''different product''' from the Original-era '''Galaxy at War''' plan. Do not merge the two.

== V-set / Virtual Block 9.2 ==

Related (but '''not''' a second Polish &ldquo;Virtual Set &hellip; niewydany&rdquo; row): Virtual Block / V-set '''9.2'''.

* Players Committee virtual-slips still lists Legacy Blocks including '''9.1''' and '''9.2'''. Listing on that page is '''not''' by itself proof that 9.2 shipped as a full released set.<ref name="vslips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], starwarsccg.org</ref>
* In the Advocate Council announce '''Reset of Standard Format''' (byline '''July 25th, 2014'''), the Advocates stated: &ldquo;'''9.2 will not be released in its current form.''' We are planning on releasing a mini, 12 card set for Worlds&hellip; We don&rsquo;t want to release a set just to have it deleted in some fashion months later.&rdquo;<ref name="reset-announce">[http://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format] (Wayback id_ capture), starwarsccg.org &mdash; byline darkjediknight11, July 25th, 2014</ref>

This wiki does '''not''' claim that VB/V-set 9.2 was fully released, and does '''not''' invent a second Polish cancelled Virtual Set from the 9.2 note. Exact fate/title of any Worlds &ldquo;mini ~12-card&rdquo; product vs the virtual-slips &ldquo;9.2&rdquo; listing remains an open gap. Full Reset context: [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]].
